title: How I AI: How this founder built a better Duolingo with Codex
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
summary: In this episode, he shows how he used Codex and GPT-Live to build native iOS and Android apps despite having no Swift or Kotlin experience, and explains how he designed Mural to teach through complete immersion. He also walks through the Lord of the Rings–themed team of Grok Bots that helps him run a 25-person company, from Gandalf as chief of staff to Legolas in marketing and Aragorn in sales.
takeaways: The technical stack followed the product vision, not the skills of the founder.
He also walks through the Lord of the Rings–themed team of Grok Bots that helps him run a 25-person company, from Gandalf as chief of staff to Legolas in marketing and Aragorn in sales.
Product management experience translates directly into better prompting.
